leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct an Angular service to manage JWT token storage and retrieval
Implement token decoding logic using the jwt-decode library in a TypeScript service
Configure Angular HTTP interceptors to automatically attach JWT tokens to outgoing requests
Initialize and bind decoded token data to Angular component properties for display
Integrate token validation checks within Angular route guards for protected routes
Manipulate token storage using browser localStorage with proper error handling
Render user information from decoded JWT tokens in Angular template views
